Otherwise, the event will be forcibly terminated."<FC:B4:3E>
Touya: "So this is the hangar..."
Yamato: "Hmm... I thought it'd be pretty cluttered,
but it feels like everything's arranged efficiently..."
Mechanic A: "Aren't those damaged parts replaced yet?!"
Mechanic B: "Baldock and Drydes are done!
Zeifon and Vishal still need work."
Mechanic A: "Don't drag your feet! You have to finish
before we arrive, whatever it takes!"
Mechanic E: "...Think the chief rubbed off on that one too?"
Mechanic C: "...Pretty strict, huh?"
Mechanic B: "You there! Get your hands moving before your mouths!"
Mechanic E: "Ooh, scary."
Mechanic C: "Y-Yes! U-Um... This part...
It's for Zeifon, if I remember right..."
Touya: "It's pretty noisy in here."
Yamato: "It really is..."
Look for Celica.
Watch the mechanics.
Touya: "Doesn't look like she's here..."
Yamato: "Oh, she's over there in the back.
That's... Fain with her.
They seem to be arguing about something..."
Touya: "Let's take a look."
Celica: "Like. I. Said. If you stay that close,
you're getting in the way of my work. Understand?"
Fain: "But..."
Celica: "Look, I'm glad you're guarding me,
but I can't move freely with you right next to me, can I?"
Fain: "However..."
Celica: "No means no.
I'm telling you I'm fine. Got it?"
Fain: "...Y-Yes, I understand..."
Celica: "Then hurry up and move away."
Fain: "..."
Celica: "Farther."
Fain: "..."
Celica: "Farther."
Fain: "..."
Celica: "Good. You're not allowed any closer than that. All right?"
Fain: "..."
Celica: "Well? Where's your answer?"
Fain: "...Yes."
Touya: "Hey."
Celica: "Hmm? Oh, it's Touya and Yamato."
Yamato: "Hello, Lady Celica."
Celica: "Just Celica is fine.
I don't really like being called that, you know."
Yamato: "Oh, u-um, okay.
I'll call you that from now on, then."
Celica: "Yes, please do."
Fain: "What is it? Do you need something?"
Celica: "Hey, Fain!
I told you to stay back!"
Fain: "B-But..."
Celica: "Are you going to make me say it all again?"
Fain: "I-I understand..."
Mechanic A: "Chief, what's wrong?"
Celica: "No, it's nothing.
Oh, right. I haven't even introduced you to them yet."
Yamato: "Huh? N-Now that you mention it..."
Mechanic A: "Hey! We're refitting Zeifon's armor.
Send that over here!"
Mechanic C: "Y-Yes! I'll do it!"
Touya: "..."
Mechanic E: "...Are you Mr. Touya?"
Touya: "Whoa!"
Yamato: "W-When did you get behind us...?"
Mechanic E: "You're wide open."
Touya: "...Well, I was an ordinary civilian until recently."
Mechanic E: "But you've got a good look in your eyes.
You'll make a good pilot."
Touya: "Well, thanks."
Celica: "Oh, Touya. What's up?"
Yamato: "Oh, Lady Celica."
Celica: "Just Celica is fine. I don't really like being called
that sort of thing, you know."
Yamato: "Oh, u-um, okay.
I'll call you that from now on, then."
Celica: "Okay.
...But what brings you here?
Have you taken a little interest in Spirit Mechs, perhaps?"
Touya: "No, I just..."
Celica: "Hmm... Oh, right.
You haven't met everyone yet, have you?
I'll introduce you."
Touya: "Huh? Oh, yeah..."
Celica: "Everyone! Stop work for a moment! Gather round!"
Mechanic A: "Everyone, stop work!
Gather round the chief!"
Celica: "Well, everyone here used to be a mechanic in York.
They don't measure up to me, but they're pretty good."
Mechanic A: "There aren't many people
who can reach your level, Chief."
Celica: "He's the one who actually gives the orders.
You could call him my star pupil."
Mechanic A: "Pupil? That's a bit much.
...Nice to meet you. I look forward to working with you."
Touya: "Y-Yeah... Likewise."
Celica: "And these are the rest of his crew."
Mechanic B: "So we all get lumped together?
Well, I don't mind."
Mechanic C: "N-Nice to meet you."
Mechanic D: "...Nice to meet you."
Mechanic E: "I'm expecting good things from you."
Mechanic F: "Try not to break too much."
Touya: "Yeah... Good to meet you."
Celica: "Now, this is Touya Kazami.
I'm sure you've heard the rumors. He's Zeifon's pilot.
...And that concludes the introductions!
All right, everyone, back to work!
Finish everything before we arrive, okay?"
Mechanic A: "Understood! Come on, back to your stations!"
Touya: "...Wait, do you maintain all the Spirit Mechs
with just this many people?"
Celica: "That's right. Well, they're all professionals,
so we work more efficiently than if we just added more people.
It's fine as it is."
Touya: "Still, it must be tough, right?"
Celica: "Well, yes. They're assembled, but they're still
unstable. Honestly, they're such troublesome children."
Touya: "Children, huh..."
Celica: "Oh, right. Would you help me with the checks, if you don't mind?
I'd like to gather data on the pilot response coefficient too. How about it?"
Touya: "Huh? All of a sudden, you want me to...?"
Celica: "You're here anyway, so why not?"
Sure, I don't mind.
Sorry, I'm not in the mood.
Celica: "Really? That'll be a big help!
Well then, to start with..."
Celica: "Okaaay! Thanks for your hard work!"
Touya: "Aaagh, I'm beat!"
Celica: "Here you go."
Touya: "What's this?"
Celica: "Karam water. It's a popular drink around here.
It isn't a natural drink, but its composition is adjusted
to resemble bodily fluids, so it's absorbed quickly."
Touya: "Huh... Like a sports drink?
Gulp, gulp, gulp... Ahh! That's pretty good."
Celica: "Isn't it? Now, come on."
Touya: "What's that hand for?"
Celica: "What do you mean? That's mine."
Touya: "Huh?"
Celica: "There aren't any vending machines on this level,
so everyone brings their own drinks.
Which means that one's mine."
Touya: "O-Oh... Thanks for the drink."
Celica: "You're welcome."
Mechanic A: "Chief, we're finished over here too!"
Celica: "Oh, coming! See you, Touya.
I'll be counting on you again!"
Touya: "..."
Yamato: "An indirect kiss! An indirect kiiiss!"
Touya: "Shut up."
Celica: "Aww, come on. Just a little?"
Touya: "You say 'a little,' but you're planning to do all the things
you normally can't in one go, aren't you?"
Celica: "Urk! Y-You saw through me?"
Touya: "Besides, I'm not exactly free all day either.
Well, good luck."
Celica: "Oh, hey!"
Fain: "..."
Touya: "...What's he doing?"
Yamato: "He seems entranced by that Armored Mech...
I think its name was Ragrade, wasn't it?"
Touya: "...Hey."
Fain: "..."
Touya: "...Hey!"
Fain: "..."
Touya: "Hey!"
Fain: "...Hmm? What, it's you. Be quiet."
Touya: "Nice greeting. It's because you were ignoring me!"
Fain: "I'm busy right now."
Touya: "Busy staring at that?"
Fain: "You look at this machine and feel nothing?!
Not even these flowing lines that sweep from its neck
to its chest?!"
Touya: "..."
Fain: "Oh... How lamentable.
You don't know one twelfth of life's pleasures..."
Touya: "Don't go deciding what makes my life fun."
Fain: "Very well! I shall explain this machine
to you! Listen closely!"
Yamato: "...He's nyot listening at all."
Fain: "Art Wesper is..."
Touya: "..."
Fain: "..."
Touya: "...What's wrong?"
Fain: "Oh! I'd forgotten!
Lord Reduce was going to give me some training now!
We'll talk another time!"
Yamato: "Huh? Is his training over already?"
Touya: "...Who knows? Let's talk to him, anyway.
Fain: "Hmm? Oh, it's you."
Touya: "Is your training over already?"
Fain: "No. Instead of training, I'm being shown Ragrade.
That's what we decided."
Touya: "Ragrade's this Armored Mech, right?"
Fain: "Yes. Well? Isn't it thrilling?"
Touya: "What's thrilling?"
Fain: "Don't give me that!
When you look at this machine... Wait, I said this
earlier, didn't I? Anyway, this Art Wesper is..."
Reduce: "The culmination of York's Armored Mech technology.
When it was first unveiled, its delicate, flowing lines
drew admiration, yet the machine was thought unable to withstand actual combat,
and engineers abroad laughed at it as a 'pretty doll.'
But that same year,
it saw its first action in a skirmish with the Republic of Zigrim,
and overturned that assessment..."
Touya: "You're..."
Fain: "Lord Reduce!"
Reduce: "My apologies. I didn't mean to eavesdrop,
but I missed my chance to speak."
Fain: "Not at all. I was waiting for you.
There is no need for Lord Reduce to apologize!"
Reduce: "As I said earlier, there's no need for such formalities with me.
Please speak normally."
Fain: "No. These things must be done
properly!"
Reduce: "Well, if you insist, I don't mind..."
Touya: "...Hey, is this Armored Mech really that amazing?"
Fain: "Of course! There are only three in the whole world,
and its pilot is Lord Reduce, one of the Three Sword Knights,
after all."
Reduce: "I'm grateful you think so highly of it, but
the Art Wesper series, including this Ragrade,
has less potential than Spirit Mechs.
Its days among the Four Great Armored Mechs of the Continent are long past."
Touya: "...Can I ask a few questions?"
Reduce: "What are they?"
Touya: "Question 1: What's Art Wesper?
Question 2: Why are there only three?
Question 3: What are the Four Great Armored Mechs of the Continent?"
Reduce: "Well, to answer your first question,
Art Wesper is the formal name given to this machine.
And the first of those Art Wespers
is this Ragrade."
Touya: "I see."
Reduce: "The answer to your next question is clear.
They were planned as a set of three from the outset,
and their designer, Dr. Kurt Elk Plaam,
has passed away."
Touya: "Even if the designer's dead, the data and stuff
must still be around, right? Couldn't they build more?"
Reduce: "No. The doctor was extremely secretive,
and handled all the important parts alone.
Now we can make the same thing, but can't reproduce its performance.
There must have been something beyond the numbers,
but there's no way to find out now."
Touya: "Huh."
Reduce: "Furthermore, one of the basic principles of Armored Mech design,
the use of standardized parts, was disregarded.
Every component is custom-made.
That means enormous costs for operation and maintenance,
which is another of the reasons."
Fain: "But pursuing strength as an individual machine, rather than
versatility, limited the people capable of piloting it,
yet its performance left other countries' Armored Mechs
unable to keep up.
I believe the doctor's judgment was correct!"
Reduce: "Heh... As a knight's mount, yes.
But as a weapon, it would be difficult to manage.
Now, as for the last question..."
Fain: "Let me answer that one!"
Reduce: "Y-Yes... Please do, then."
Fain: "...Ahem! The Four Great Armored Mechs of the Continent are:
the mount of the Royal Knights of Agarthia's 'Phoenix Knight,'
my master, Lord Rest: Zaxas;
the mount of the former commander of the Kingdom of Agarthia's Royal Knights,
the 'Crimson Knight,' Lord Gaius: Zaiks;
Griol, piloted by Zigrim's 'Lion of the West,' Lord Grad;
and finally, the mount of Limberg's 'Azure Ravenous Wolf,' esteemed Orkis:
Blau Abend. Those are the four.
Sadly, Lord Gaius went missing nine years ago,
and the Armored Mech Zaiks
was lost as well."
Touya: "..."
Fain: "Hmm? What's wrong?"
Touya: "Nothing. All this Knight of Whatever and Ravenous Wolf stuff...
I was just thinking how you all have such grand names..."
Fain: "Heh... It seems you don't understand how thrillingly cool they are.
Clearly, you still have much training to do."
Touya: "...I'm fine with not understanding."
Fain: "What?! After all that, you still don't understand?!
Argh! I'll educate you!"
Touya: "No thanks. I'm not buying what you're selling."
Fain: "Grrr!"
Reduce: "Calm down. Forcing your views on others
isn't particularly admirable."
Fain: "Urk..."
Touya: "Heh!"
Touya: "O-Ow! What's that sword made of?!"
Reduce: "And you, don't provoke Fain."
Fain: "Heh heh!"
Reduce: "..."
Yamato: "You'll just wear yourself out taking them seriously.
Humor them, and they'll make up
or whatever all by themselves."
Reduce: "...Is that how it works?"
Yamato: "You can't expect those two to change their personalities,
can you? They're so easy to read, I can say that already,
even after this short time. Especially Fain."
Fain: "...Well, if you can't understand
the greatness of knighthood, so be it.
I'll simply show you how wonderful it is through my own deeds."
Touya: "I'll look forward to that."
Fain: "Just you watch.
I'll dazzle you with how cool I am.
Heh heh heh... Dahahahaha!"
Reduce: "Hmm. Indeed..."
Yamato: "...? Oh, it's Fain and Mr. Reduce.
It looks like he's been getting some training.
Though they seem to be finishing up."
Talk to them.
Leave.
Fain: "...Hmm? What, it's you."
Touya: "You're working hard."
Fain: "Of course. Opportunities to train under one of the Three Sword Knights
are few and far between.
As a knight, I must not let this chance slip away!"
Touya: "Huh..."
Reduce: "...Fain. Why did you become a knight?"
Fain: "To... uphold my own sense of justice, of course!"
Reduce: "Then what do you think a knight is?"
Fain: "A knight... A knight is someone who has offered their sword to a king,
and sworn loyalty, earning that honorable title!"
Reduce: "Then, without a king to serve,
a person cannot be a knight?"
Fain: "Of course not!"
Reduce: "Fain. Serving a king is not the only thing
that qualifies someone to be a knight.
What matters is the heart within their breast."
Fain: "Their heart...?"
Reduce: "And from the moment you pledge to risk your own life
to protect someone, you become a knight.
A king is not the only person worthy of your sword."
Fain: "But you too, Lord Reduce..."
Reduce: "It's true that I am Her Majesty's knight.
But that's simply because she was the person I offered my sword to.
Not to Alforina as a sovereign, but to Alforina
herself, I offered my sword.
I am proud to be Her Majesty's knight."
Fain: "Oh! How magnificent...!
That's Lord Reduce of the Three Sword Knights for you!
I'm deeply moved!
You are too, aren't you?!"
Touya: "Huh?!"
Y-Yeah, of course.
No, that's...
Fain: "I knew it! I knew it!
Wahahahaha!"
Reduce: "In any case, being proud of your knighthood
is a good thing, but being bound by it is dangerous.
It's important to follow your own heart."
Fain: "Then there is no problem.
The flame of justice burning bright within my heart
cries out for me to vanquish evil!"
Reduce: "That's merely being honest with your own desires.
What I'm saying is..."
Fain: "No one can calm or extinguish
this burning passion in my soul! Dahahahaha!"
Yamato: "...He doesn't seem to be listening."
Reduce: "..."
Yamato: "Hey, Touya, shall we go somewhere else now?"
Touya: "Y-Yeah, you're right... Well, I'll leave the rest to you."
Reduce: "Y-Yes..."
Fain: "What?! You really are...
...Well, never mind. There's no point asking someone who isn't a knight
to understand what knighthood means.
I was wrong to ask. Yes. You may go now."
Touya: "...When you put it like that... What is it, Yamato?"
Yamato: "We shouldn't get in their way any longer,
so let's go somewhere else."
Touya: "...Oh well. All right.
See you, Reduce."
Reduce: "Yes."
Fain: "Hey! Aren't you going to say goodbye to me...?"
Touya: "Come on, let's go."
Fain: "Nuooh! You're ignoring me..."
Reduce: "Don't pick a fight over every little thing.
You won't be a fine knight unless you improve that attitude.
A knight should be a model for others."
Fain: "Grrrr..."
Yamato: "W-Well, see you."
Fain: "...Hmm? Oh, it's Touya! What is it?"
Touya: "I wanted to ask you a little about that 'Silver Knight'
you mentioned earlier."
Fain: "Oh! Have you finally awakened
to the greatness of knighthood?!"
Touya: "No, that's not really it, but..."
Fain: "Very well! I shall tell you!"
Touya: "..."
Fain: "As you know, the 'Silver Knight'
is another name for Lord Reduce of the Three Sword Knights.
Lord Reduce's beloved Ragrade has mirror-finish armor,
which gleams silver.
And in time, Lord Reduce, who fights in that machine,
came to be called 'Reduce the Silver' and the 'Silver Wolf,'
and became generally known as the 'Silver Knight.'
Such an epithet is an honor
for a knight. Someday, I too... Heh heh heh."
Touya: "Is Tyron as famous as Reduce,
by any chance?"
Fain: "Of course! Though the only one with an epithet
is Lord Reduce, the other Three Sword Knights
are every bit as skilled at piloting Armored Mechs."
Touya: "The Three Sword Knights, huh..."
Fain: "The title 'Three Sword Knights' refers to those sworn to York's House Istarsh:
three knights, each an outstanding
Armored Mech pilot and a pillar of York's defense.
York has repelled Zigrim's invasions for so many years
thanks to Lord Garyud's efforts, but also because the Three Sword Knights
were there to protect it."
Touya: "I see. So that's why they scattered them
before attacking..."
Fain: "Yes. It's just the sort of underhanded trick those Zigrim
bastards, who know nothing but fighting, would come up with."
Touya: "Yeah."
Fain: "...Now, next, the origins of knighthood..."
Yamato: "Yikes. This one sounds like it'll take a while..."
Touya: "W-Well, we'd better get going."
Fain: "...Hmm. I see. What a pity."
Touya: "See you."
Fain: "Yes."
